# Canvix menu geometry attribution

Source: https://github.com/mir-ashiq/canvix
Revision: `50a4fe5a44c56fb7939e91338ae920a22d6a81ce`
Original files:
- `src/lib/templates/collection-v07.ts`: `artisan-menu` (Artisan Cafe Menu)
- `src/lib/templates/collection-v08-print.ts`: `cafe-menu` (Cafe Menu Board)
License: MIT; see bundled LICENSE (copyright 2026 Ashiq Hussain Mir).

The source index defines **122 original documents** and computes **244 theme/typographic variants**, totaling 366 across unrelated types. Only the two listed originals are complete cafe menu print documents. The source's text, borders, graphic shapes, coordinates, typography and page formats were converted into typed JSON metadata; it is not loaded as runtime JS or a second account/database. Original sample business/dishes/prices are replaced by the authorized owner catalog at render. The menu browser's optional style variants are not counted as independent source documents. Other Canvix food-related records are promotional posters, not full menus.
